Buffalo Chicken Wings:

Cut off all the feathers. If you wanna cut the wings in half you can, but you don't have to. You're just gonna lay it out flat in the pan. You're gonna to take Frank's RedHot Original Buffalo Wings Sauce and just put it over the chicken, Just spread it around. Then you're gonna put it in the oven on the broil. So if you're leaving on broil you're gonna wait until it looks a little charred but not like burnt. Until you seen brown bubbles on top of the chicken. And then there's no timing, just really keep an eye on it. Um and then once you see those little brown bubbles on top, you take it out, flip them over, put a litle bit more sauce, put it in again on, broil, and same thing. Let it get that like brownish color little bottles on top. And then when you're done, you'll switch over to like just regular bake at 350 F for ten minutes. Just so that way you know it's fully cooked or that's it.
